definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something with a dignified, noble appearance that commands respect. Often implies a combination of strength, determination, and grace.

examples.japanese: {凛々|りり}しい⟦{顔|かお}つき→顔つき：19660_kaotsuki⟧
⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凛々|りり}しく⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: She looked gallant in her uniform.

examples.japanese: {凛々|りり}しい⟦{眉|まゆ}→眉：04267_mayu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{若|わか}い⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{城門|じょうもん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}っていた→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: A young samurai with a noble brow was guarding the castle gate.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: I-adjective.

ADJECTIVE FORMS:
- Adverb: {凛々|りり}しく (gallantly, nobly)
- Noun form: {凛々|りり}しさ (gallantness, nobility)

ORTHOGRAPHY: Can also be written as {凛|りん}りんしい or りりしい, though {凛々|りり}しい is the most common kanji form.

NUANCE: {凛々|りり}しい often describes the appearance or bearing of someone, particularly their facial features or posture. It carries connotations of both inner strength and outward dignity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凛々|りり}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧/⟦{顔|かお}つき→顔つき：19660_kaotsuki⟧ (dignified face)
- {凛々|りり}しい⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧ (gallant figure)
- {凛々|りり}しい⟦{眉|まゆ}→眉：04267_mayu⟧ (noble eyebrows)
- {凛々|りり}しく⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand gallantly)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{凛|りん}とした→凛とした：16390_rintoshita⟧ (dignified, crisp)
- ⟦{堂々|どうどう}→堂々：05895_doudou⟧とした (imposing, stately)
